install_tell: pip install gpt-researcher  (or: git clone + pip install -r requirements.txt + python -m uvicorn main:app --reload, port 8000)
misconfig_patterns: No auth middleware on any route -- all endpoints accessible without credentials by default
CORS defaults allow localhost:3000 and 127.0.0.1:3000; CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS not set in most deployments, so origin restriction is absent
DOC_PATH (./my-docs) and REPORT_STORE_PATH (data/reports.json) exposed via /files/ and /api/reports with no access control
POST /upload/ accepts arbitrary file uploads without auth
WebSocket /ws streams research progress (including scraped source content) to any connected client
LLM provider API keys (OPENAI_API_KEY, TAVILY_API_KEY) stored server-side but accessible to any process with filesystem access if .env is misplaced

active_probe.false_positive_check: Confirm JSON array or object response containing research_id field. A 200 returning HTML or non-GPTR JSON is a catch-all or reverse-proxy FP. Pair with /ws WebSocket upgrade check (101 Switching Protocols) as secondary confirm. The underscore variant http.html:"gpt_researcher" (64 hits) fires on bundled JS module names in the SPA -- higher population but same platform, not a distinct product.

shodan_dorks.note: basic (27 hits, all HTTP 200, 0 HTTP 401) is the tightest population-to-noise ratio. strict variant uses the Python module name embedded in bundled JS (64 hits) -- broader but same platform. TLS subset port:443 = 6 hits, highest-value tier (likely prod deployments behind reverse proxy). Hyphen variant http.html:"gpt-researcher" without port = 54 hits. Zero 401s confirmed across all confirmed instances.

deployment_tells: Port 8000 open (uvicorn default) with FastAPI JSON responses
React SPA frontend on port 3000 in docker-compose deployments (frontend container)
WebSocket endpoint /ws for real-time research progress streaming
POST /report/ accepts {query, report_type, report_source} with no auth token
GPTR branding in page title and bundled JS (both 'gpt-researcher' and 'gpt_researcher' strings)
pivot_paths: GET /api/reports -> enumerate all stored research reports (IDs, queries, status) without credentials
GET /api/reports/{research_id} -> retrieve full synthesized research document
GET /files/ -> directory listing of uploaded/processed documents in DOC_PATH
POST /api/multi_agents -> trigger multi-agent research workflow (LLM API key consumption)
WebSocket /ws -> monitor live research sessions including scraped source URLs and intermediate synthesis
GET /api/reports/{research_id}/chat -> retrieve chat history for a specific research session
auth_evidence: No auth middleware is configured in backend/server/app.py. CORS middleware uses CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS env var but defaults to localhost origins with no token/session requirement. README quickstart: export OPENAI_API_KEY + export TAVILY_API_KEY + python -m uvicorn main:app --reload -- no auth setup step exists. All 27 Shodan hits on http.html:"gpt-researcher" port:8000 returned HTTP 200; zero HTTP 401 across the confirmed population. .env.example ships with all credential fields empty (OPENAI_API_KEY=, TAVILY_API_KEY=) -- no auth token field exists in the env schema. The platform is a research synthesis tool (outbound HTTP for web fetching), NOT a shell-exec agent -- capability ceiling is LLM API consumption and web scraping, not arbitrary code execution.
sensitive_assets: Stored research reports containing synthesized content from scraped sources (/api/reports)
Uploaded documents in DOC_PATH accessible via /files/ directory listing
LLM API key consumption via POST /report/ and /api/multi_agents (LLMjacking surface)
Scraped source content streamed over unauthenticated WebSocket /ws
Multi-agent workflow definitions and intermediate outputs (/api/multi_agents)
